option_relations.rationale: Epidermolytic ichthyosis (bullous congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma) is a condition characterized by hyperkeratosis, vacuolization in the granular and upper spinous layers, and bullae formation within the epidermis, which matches the description of Epidermolytic Hyperkeratosis (B3.1).
Superficial epidermolytic ichthyosis does not match the clinical and histopathological features described in the vignette.
Ichthyosis bullosa of Siemens does not match the clinical and histopathological features described in the vignette.
Annular epidermolytic ichthyosis (AEI) does not match the clinical and histopathological features described in the vignette.
